Function FullCanvasObjectMixin

FullCanvasObjectMixin(Base: typeof DisplayObject): any

Augment any PIXI.DisplayObject to assume bounds that are always aligned with the full
visible screen. The bounds of this container do not depend on its children but always fill the
entire canvas.

Parameters

Base: typeof DisplayObject

Any PIXI DisplayObject subclass

Returns any

The decorated subclass with full canvas bounds
